latest_accepted_task.title: Connect guarded production identity adapter to PostgreSQL persistence

completed_task_chain.summary: Production architecture and release hardening plan
Guarded production migration loader and read-only workspace context
Explicit production migration runner and workspace resolution plan
Production identity repository and guarded workspace persistence resolution
Guarded production identity persistence adapter scaffold

accepted_behavior_after_task_034: PostgreSQL adapter is explicit and injectable.
Adapter can use injected query function, client.query, or pool.query.
Adapter exposes tenant and workspace lookup methods.
No real PostgreSQL server is required by tests.
Repository only uses PostgreSQL adapter when productionMode is explicitly enabled or a production adapter/query/client/pool is explicitly supplied.
safety_boundaries: Do not break local SQLite MVP startup.
Do not require PostgreSQL during default local startup.
Do not run production migrations automatically.
Do not introduce login requirements yet.
Do not change Client Workspace behavior.
Do not change Admin Dashboard behavior unless explicitly requested.
Do not expose provider settings, API-key controls, or Agent Connector controls in Client Workspace.
Do not enable local agent bridge/chat by default.
Do not allow arbitrary browser-submitted shell commands.
Do not add private runtime configuration values to the repository.
Do not claim completion without validation evidence.

hermes_queue_rule.important_note: EAI-TASK numbers and GitHub issue numbers are not the same thing. EAI-TASK-034 was GitHub issue #56.
